label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: y verá el sacerdote, y he aquí en piel de su carne manchas oscuras blancas: bohaq él; brotó en la piel; puro él.
spanish: y verá el sacerdote, y he aquí en piel de su carne manchas apagadas blancas: erupción él; brotó en la piel; puro él.
grammarChanges: Translated the untranslated lemma 'bohaq' (H933, masc. sg. common noun) to the Spanish common noun 'erupción' instead of leaving it as a transliteration.
Replaced 'oscuras' with 'apagadas' for כֵּהוֹת (H3544, fem. pl.) so it reads as a dimmed/faint quality of white rather than a second, darker color beside 'blancas'.
readerNote: Chose 'erupción' as the Spanish common noun for בֹּהַק (H933), since the auditor flagged it as untranslated but the lexeme itself allows more than one acceptable Spanish rendering of this one-time technical skin-condition term.
